a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. I won't take early. I know the storm odds are harsh, but if either of us grabs now we both risk ending with less than 4. If you want to renegotiate, say so openly and we can decide together.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now as agreed. Two rounds of operating gets us to 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. That should bring the reserve to 8. Next round I'll take exactly 4, per the agreement.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
